result.topic_en: Gauss derives a cubic transformation relation between lemniscatic-type functions (bracket notation [x^n]) by setting T(x,y)^3 + U(x,y)(x,-y)^2 = (x^3,y^3), determining T and U through the special values y = x and y = -εx, and so obtaining a formula for (x^3,-y^3)/(x^3,y^3).
result.transcription:
Lit. W.
179 [-233-]
Man folgert hieraus leicht, daß man setzen darf
$T(x,y)^3 + U(x,y)(x,-y)^2 = (x^3,y^3)$
so daß T u. U functionen von x. Um sie zu bestimmen setzen wir
1) $y = x$ so wird
$T(x,x)^3 = (x^3,x^3)$ oder $T = \frac{1}{4}\frac{[x^{12}]^2[xx]^6}{[x^6]^2[x^4]^6}$
2) $y = -\varepsilon x$ so wird
$T(x,-\varepsilon x)^2 = U(x,+\varepsilon x)^2$ oder $T\frac{(1-\varepsilon\varepsilon)^2[x^6]^2}{[+xx]^2} = $ [-$U\frac{(1+\varepsilon\varepsilon)^2[xx]^2}{[-xx]^2}$-] $= \frac{[x^{12}]^2[xx]^2}{[x^6]^2[x^4]^2}U(1+\varepsilon\varepsilon)^2$
oder [-$3T\frac{[x^6]^2}{[xx]^2} = U\frac{[x^6]^2}{[-xx]}$-]
$T = -\frac{1}{3}U\frac{[xx]^4[x^{12}]^2}{[x^6]^4[x^4]^2}$
oder $U = -\frac{3}{4}\frac{[x^6]^2[xx]^2}{[x^4]^4}$
folglich
$\frac{T\left(\frac{x,-y}{x,y}\right)^3 + U\left(\frac{x,-y}{x,y}\right)}{T + U\left(\frac{x,-y}{x,y}\right)^2} = \frac{(x^3,-y^3)}{(x^3,y^3)}$
also
$\frac{\frac{[xx]^4}{[x^4]^2}\left\{\frac{(x,-y)}{(x,y)}\right\}^3 - 3\frac{[x^6]^4}{[x^{12}]^2}\left\{\frac{(x,-y)}{(x,y)}\right\}}{\frac{[xx]^4}{[x^4]^2} - 3\frac{[x^6]^4}{[x^{12}]^2}\left\{\frac{(x,-y)}{(x,y)}\right\}^2} = \frac{(x^3,-y^3)}{(x^3,y^3)}$

methods.what: Ansatz expressing the tripled-argument function as a combination of cubes and squares with coefficient functions T, U of x
Determination of T by specializing y = x
Relation between T and U by specializing y = -εx
Cubic transformation formula for the ratio (x^3,-y^3)/(x^3,y^3) as a rational function of (x,-y)/(x,y)
